summary: Sdiptech AB (publ) provides technical services for infrastructures in Sweden, the United Kingdom, Germany, Denmark, Italy, the Netherlands, Norway, Finland, the Unites States, and internationally. The company provides water and wastewater treatment and purification, water distribution and management systems, and infrastructure and environmental solutions; energy and electrification solutions for energy efficiency, electrification, power supply, and temporary electricity; automation, material handling optimization, logistics optimization, road winter maintenance and systems, and controlling systems. It also offers safety and security services; and digital technology for speed monitoring and infrastructure for air traffic communication. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
